meta.name: gws
meta.description: This skill should be used when interacting with Google Workspace services via the gws CLI — Gmail (search, triage, send, labels, filters, drafts), Calendar (agenda, events, Meet conferencing), Drive (upload, list, share, download), Sheets (read, append), Docs, Tasks, Chat (send), People/Contacts, and cross-service workflows (standup, meeting prep, weekly digest, email-to-task). Triggers on queries like "check my email", "search Gmail", "send email", "calendar agenda", "create calendar event", "upload to Drive", "read spreadsheet", "create a task", "triage inbox", "find contact", "post to Chat".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言管理 Google 工作空间
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常依赖 Google 办公套件处理邮件、日程和文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage Google Workspace with natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you rely on Google Workspace for email, calendar, and files.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 gws 命令行工具操作 Google Workspace，包括查看和发送 Gmail 邮件、管理日历日程、上传和分享 Drive 文件、读写 Sheets 表格、创建 Tasks 任务、发送 Chat 消息等。
howto.when: 当你提到“查邮件”、“发邮件”、“日历日程”、“上传文件”、“创建任务”等与 Google Workspace 相关的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的日历日程
给张三发一封邮件，主题是会议提醒
把 report.pdf 上传到我的 Drive

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate Google Workspace via the gws CLI: check/send Gmail, manage calendar events, upload/share Drive files, read/append Sheets, create Tasks, post to Chat, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention requests related to Google Workspace, such as "check email", "send email", "calendar agenda", "upload file", "create task", etc.

say_en.text: Check my calendar agenda for today.
say_en.note: Claude will run gws calendar +agenda to show today's events.

say_en.text: Send an email to John about the meeting reminder.
say_en.note: Claude will use gws gmail +send to send the email.
Claude will execute gws drive +upload to upload the file.
